request.state: Audit of an arithmetic/data-ingestion bug, not a political assessment. Classify only the exact source facts in the question.

overlap.instructions: The published total is 40,564,674.03. FEC raw rows contain 25 regular-report UDP transactions totaling 20,140,908.74, plus 24 primary-election notice transactions totaling 20,139,904.21 and 3 general-election notices totaling 283,861.08. Every one of the 24 primary notices has the identical transaction ID AND dollar amount as a regular-report row. All 52 rows have most_recent=true. The old collector sums all 52 rows. Does the published total count the 24 matching expenditures twice?

criteria.yes: The collector counts all 24 matching notice/regular transactions twice
criteria.no: There is no duplicated spending in this sum
criteria.uncertain: These facts do not establish whether there is duplication
